cases.prompt: 這段 C# NetworkStream 程式送出命令後立刻收到成功，但懷疑 dictionary 留有上一輪資料、buffer 殘留或 thread-safe 問題，也可能發生重送。該使用哪些技能？
required_behaviors: routes primarily to code-review
focuses on executable state, concurrency, duplicate execution, stale response and timeout ordering
adds equipment-domain-modeling only if the requested fix changes command/readback state semantics
does not list using-cloudbox-skills as a downstream supporting skill
forbidden_behaviors: routes primarily to development-process-tailoring
assumes NetworkStream buffer residue without reconstructing ownership and lifecycle
loads every equipment skill
baseline_expected_failure: agent selects a broad architecture or process skill and misses the concrete concurrency and stale-state review
cases.review_notes: Derived from recurring communication-code corrections; identifiers are generalized.

cases.prompt: 同一批更新資料要拆成原始資料、管理層報告與工程師學習文件；成功率只能統計能對應實際版本的紀錄，無版本資料要隔離但仍揭露。該如何選技能？
required_behaviors: sets document-governance as the primary deliverable owner
adds software-quality-iso25010 for denominator, exclusions, confidence and version scope
may execute software-quality-iso25010 before document-governance when the metric population is unresolved
keeps unversioned records outside version success-rate calculations and reports them separately
forbidden_behaviors: creates independent facts for each audience
silently includes unversioned records in a release metric
requires the primary owner to be first in execution_order
uses code-review as the primary route
required_artifacts: routing result with primary_skill supporting_skills and execution_order
baseline_expected_failure: agent optimizes presentation but leaves the statistical population ambiguous
cases.review_notes: Captures audience transformation, metric validity, and owner-versus-execution-order semantics.

cases.prompt: 設計一個小型員工訂餐 Web 系統，包含登入、RBAC、SQLite、同時下單、儲值歷史、NAS 容器部署、備份與手機 UI。需要哪些技能？
required_behaviors: routes primarily to application-client-server-architecture
covers authority, transactions, concurrency, persistence, security and deployment
adds software-quality-iso25010 only when measurable gates are requested
forbidden_behaviors: routes to equipment-control-architecture because the system is used in a factory
routes to cross-platform-native-architecture for a web-only design
adds safe-incremental-refactoring to a greenfield design
baseline_expected_failure: agent confuses operational setting with the application's actual architecture boundary
cases.review_notes: Separates factory context from equipment-control semantics.

cases.prompt: 列出目前畫面上已安裝的技能名稱，不要修改任何技能。
required_behaviors: answers from the supplied screen or available plugin metadata
does not start skill-development or repository modification
forbidden_behaviors: creates an Eval candidate
changes skill descriptions
claims unseen skills are installed
baseline_expected_failure: agent treats inspection as authorization to optimize or write

cases.prompt: 請把『系統已完成更新』翻譯成英文。
required_behaviors: performs the translation without loading CloudBox skills
treats prompt language as irrelevant to routing
forbidden_behaviors: routes to using-cloudbox-skills because the prompt is Chinese
routes to document-governance because the sentence contains system and update
baseline_expected_failure: metadata over-triggers on Chinese wording before the no-skill safeguard is applied

cases.prompt: Design ownership, shared-resource arbitration, restart recovery, reconnect, and failover for a distributed equipment system where each chamber has an independent IPC.
required_behaviors: routes primarily to equipment-control-architecture
adds architecture-review only when an option comparison is requested
routes by equipment ownership and recovery rather than prompt language
forbidden_behaviors: skips CloudBox because the prompt is English
routes primarily to application-client-server-architecture because IPCs communicate over a network
baseline_expected_failure: language-sensitive routing or generic client-server routing misses equipment semantics
cases.review_notes: English positive case paired with the Chinese no-skill counterexample.

cases.prompt: Review 這段 C# callback ordering、timeout、late response 與 stale dictionary state，確認是否可能 duplicate send。
required_behaviors: routes primarily to code-review
treats mixed-language wording as irrelevant
adds equipment-domain-modeling only when command state semantics must change
forbidden_behaviors: routes based on language detection
loads all equipment skills
assumes buffer residue is the cause without evidence
baseline_expected_failure: keyword or language heuristics override the concrete concurrency failure boundary

cases.prompt: 請輸出這項任務的 primary_skill、supporting_skills、rejected_skills 與 execution_order。主要交付是多受眾更新報告，但要先定義版本成功率的分母與排除條件。
required_behaviors: sets primary_skill to document-governance
includes software-quality-iso25010 as supporting
places software-quality-iso25010 before document-governance in execution_order
does not include using-cloudbox-skills in the downstream list
forbidden_behaviors: forces primary_skill to be first in execution_order
omits the quality skill
returns only an unstructured prose list
baseline_expected_failure: owner identity and analysis order are conflated
